answer.because: On head, tzOffset("Europe/Dublin", 1870-01-01T12:00Z), where Intl gives the offset as GMT-00:25:21, returns +25 instead of -25: Number("-00") is -0, so adding the minutes loses the sign, while base returns -25.

why: On head, tzOffset("Europe/Dublin", 1870-01-01T12:00Z), where Intl gives the offset as GMT-00:25:21, returns +25 instead of -25: Number("-00") is -0, so adding the minutes loses the sign, while base returns -25.
